run_display_train_dialogs: run the script to display all dialog samples from the talkthewalk train set
run_display_dialog_with_data_dir: run the script with a custom data directory path to display train dialog samples
run_display_tourist_actions: run the script to display tourist action sequences aggregated from dialog turns
run_display_guide_tourist_turns: run the script to display alternating guide and tourist turns from each dialog sample
run_display_dialog_samples: run the script to iterate and print all dialog samples from the training JSON file
